name: A Little Unfolding
tagline: A kinetic olive paper world. Less performing. More being.
rationale: Oversized lettering, draggable thought fragments, a curious cursor-following eye and an orbital conversation selector make an expressive personal introduction. Original code-native artwork replaces stock imagery and AI people.
typography: Locally embedded Manrope and Instrument Serif; monumental sans-serif headlines meet expressive italic gestures.
homepage: Real portrait preview and unfolding biography
mobile: Single-column compositions, touch-draggable words, tappable orbital prompts and native scrolling. Dedicated desktop/phone preview.
supporting: Optional little guide, portrait upload stored only in memory, keyboard-operated selectors and practical details.
trust: Placeholder identity, professional designation, biography and contact details must be replaced with verified therapist information.
seo: Semantic headings and readable Vancouver copy. Production title and service details require verified identity and scope.
accessibility: Reduced motion, a motion toggle, focus indicators, native buttons and details, keyboard interactions, accessible contact dialog. Dragging is optional.
tradeoff: A deliberately expressive direction. The opening prioritizes typography; his authentic portrait follows immediately. Contact is a transparent preview, not an active inquiry form.
